name: Copy job - CDC based replication from Salesforce
description: Copy job provides a Salesforce CDC connector, allowing you to capture row‑level inserts, updates, and deletes from Salesforce and replicate them to any supported destination.

result.nameEs: Copy job: replicación basada en CDC desde Salesforce
result.descriptionEs: Copy job incorporará un conector CDC de Salesforce para capturar inserciones, actualizaciones y borrados a nivel de fila y replicarlos en cualquier destino compatible.
